evals.prompt: Create a user reviews feature where users can rate and review the app. It should have a screen showing existing reviews and a form to submit a new review.
evals.expected_output: Feature folder under composeApp with composable, viewmodel, ktor api co-located. Shared data class in shared/classes/. Uses design system components (PrimaryButton, BodyMedium, AddSpace, etc). No vanilla Text/Button/Spacer. CLAUDE.md in the feature folder.

assertions.text: All client files are co-located in a single feature folder (e.g., reviews/ or userReviews/), not split across ui/, viewModels/, repositories/ folders
A CLAUDE.md file is created in the feature folder listing all files with descriptions
Data class for Review is placed in shared/src/commonMain/.../classes/, not in composeApp
No vanilla Text() composable used — only HeadlineMedium, BodyMedium, LabelLarge, etc.
No vanilla Button() used — only PrimaryButton, SecondaryButton, etc.
No hardcoded dp values (16.dp, 8.dp) — uses dimens.kt values (paddingDefault, sixteenDp, etc.)
Uses AddSpace() instead of Spacer(modifier = Modifier.height/width(...))
Colors come from MaterialTheme.colorScheme, no hardcoded Color(...) values
ViewModel has @KoinViewModel annotation
No sealed class/interface used for actions or UI state — uses direct functions and data class
Uses Kermit Logger, not println()
No @Preview functions created
No KDoc-style /** */ comments
Separates stateful Screen composable from stateless Content composable

evals.prompt: Add a server endpoint that returns user activity stats — total chats, total horoscopes viewed, and days since signup.
evals.expected_output: New route file in a feature folder with service. Flat route pattern (/getUserActivityStats). One route per file. Uses RequestKeys/KtorVariables. Auth wrapped. Data class in shared/classes/.

assertions.text: Route and service are co-located in the same feature folder (e.g., user/ or a new folder), not in separate routes/ and services/ folders
Uses flat route pattern like get("/getUserActivityStats"), not nested paths like /api/v1/user/stats
Uses query parameters, not path parameters (no /{userId} in the route)
The route handler is in its own dedicated .kt file
Route is wrapped in authenticated { } block
Uses RequestKeys or KtorVariables for parameter keys, not hardcoded strings
Service injected via Koin: val service by inject<ServiceName>()
Response data class placed in shared/classes/, not in server module
Response uses ApiResponse<T> wrapper
Any new constants are added to shared Constants.kt, not declared locally

evals.prompt: Add an empty state to the notifications screen when there are no notifications to show.
evals.expected_output: Modifies existing NotificationsComposable.kt. Uses DrawNoContentAvailable or design system components. No hardcoded dp/colors. Uses design system text composables.

assertions.text: Uses DrawNoContentAvailable or existing design system components for empty state, not custom implementation from scratch
Any new text uses wrapper composables (BodyMedium, etc.), not vanilla Text()
No hardcoded dp values in the new code
Any new colors use MaterialTheme.colorScheme, not hardcoded Color values
Changes are minimal and focused — doesn't refactor unrelated code or add unnecessary features
